description: Welcome to Solar Scape! I am running this project as a solo participant focusing on web development, UI design, and interactive STEM education. Mars Outpost Builder is fully live and ready for testing!
summary: Mars Outpost Builder is an immersive, browser-based gamified trainer designed to engage youth and aspiring space explorers in planetary outpost design. The web app features a three-tiered campaign—combining resource strategy, clue-based module configuration, and a high-stakes countdown race—teaching players the critical trade-offs of life-support, power management, and habitat engineering on Mars. Developed with vanilla HTML, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, it bridges STEM education and interactive simulation.
details:
• What it does & How it works:
  • The application takes players through three distinct mission phases on the Martian surface. In Level 1 (Outpost Strategy), players allocate scarce resources (Power, Oxygen, Water) to establish a sustainable base. Level 2 (Module Puzzle) challenges players to solve complex scientific clue readouts to configure critical systems without triggering strict failure caps. Level 3 (Countdown Race) tests quick-thinking decision-making under time pressure while avoiding decoys
  • Benefits & Impact:
  • The project serves as an interactive STEM outreach tool that simplifies complex aerospace resource management concepts into an engaging game, fostering public interest in space exploration and mission planning
  • Tools, Technologies & Software Used:
    • Frontend & Logic: HTML5, CSS3 (Tailwind CSS framework), Vanilla JavaScript.
    • Hosting & Deployment: GitHub Pages for stable, public cloud web hosting.
    • Design & Assets: Custom UI layouts and visual styling.
    • Video Editing: Canva
